CHEBI:15361.Definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of pyruvic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

CHEBI:16526.Definition: A one-carbon compound with formula CO2 in which the carbon is attached to each oxygen atom by a double bond. A colourless, odourless gas under normal conditions, it is produced during respiration by all animals, fungi and microorganisms that depend directly or indirectly on living or decaying plants for food.
CHEBI:16526.Synonyms: CO(2); CO2; E 290; E-290; E290; R-744; [CO2]; carbonic anhydride; dioxidocarbon; methanedione

CHEBI:28240.Definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of dichloroacetic acid.
CHEBI:28240.Synonyms: dichloracetate; dichloroacetate ion; dichloroacetic acid ion(1-)

CHEBI:29108.Synonyms: CALCIUM ION; Ca(2+); Ca2+; calcium(2+) ion; calcium(II) cation; calcium, doubly charged positive ion

CHEBI:57288.Definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) that is the tetraanion of acetyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups.
CHEBI:57288.Synonyms: 3'-phosphonatoadenosine 5'-(3-{(3R)-4-[(3-{[2-(acetylsulfanyl)ethyl]amino}-3-oxopropyl)amino]-3-hydroxy-2,2-dimethyl-4-oxobutyl} diphosphate); AcCoA(4-); acetyl-CoA; acetyl-CoA tetraanion; acetyl-coenzyme A(4-)

CHEBI:57540.Definition: An anionic form of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide arising from deprotonation of the two OH groups of the diphosphate moiety.

CHEBI:57945.Definition: Dianion of NADH arising from deprotonation of the two diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.
